item.title: Smarter models, defensive bets and the scraper bill
item.description:
New model integrations reach everyday tools, while abusive crawlers impose costs on the Linux kernel’s Git hosting. We examine the case for faster training as defence, plus arguments about planning, incentives and what extra thinking time can buy.
